name: aiEngine.ts
description: Layer 4 — Core inference orchestrator. 3-tier AI routing (Epistemic→Local Daemon→Sovereign). chatWithAgent(), generateReview(). Zero React imports.

name: SemanticArena.ts
description: Layer 4 — ZOH 1024-bit bitfield search engine. Popcount32 Tanimoto scoring, flat Uint32Array memory, guardrail index, POPCNT_TABLE lookup.

name: EpistemicShadow.ts
description: Layer 4 — Interruption orchestrator. Background distillation queue, distillDelta(), AbortController preemption.

name: networkGuard.ts
description: Layer 4 — SSRF prevention. checkNetworkConsent() reads db.app_settings. validateEndpointUrl() blocks private IPs, metadata endpoints, DNS rebinding. IPv6 blocking.

name: cryptoVault.ts
description: Layer 4 — DEK management. Keys exist only in RAM, wrapping keys sealed in IndexedDB. AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2.

name: db.ts
description: Layer 5 — Dexie database schema v39. Audit hooks, version migration via nextVersionAfter(). Never hardcode version.

name: inferenceWorker.ts
description: Layer 5 — Web Worker for WASM inference. Message protocol, never access WASM memory directly. Array+join token streaming.

name: SovereignEngine.ts
description: Layer 4 — Tier-3 local inference. GGUF model loading via OPFS, WebGPU compute, SharedArrayBuffer, zero-copy blitting.

name: promptBuilder.ts
description: Layer 4 — Dynamic Prompt Engine. buildPrompt(promptKey, ctx) fetches from IndexedDB, computes data placeholders via replaceTags().

name: scorecardEngine.ts
description: Layer 4 — BDAT weighted scorecard. Business/Data/Application/Technology axes with configurable weights.

name: ddqEngine.ts
description: Layer 4 — DDQ generation and parsing. generateDDQ() returns Blob, parseDDQResponse() via drag-drop. Precomputed QUESTION_MAP.

name: ragOrchestrator.ts
description: Layer 4 — RAG orchestrator. Coordinates semantic search + context assembly. findSimilarReviews() for cross-review memory.

name: threatEngine.ts
description: Layer 4 — STRIDE threat modeling. MITRE ATT&CK mapping, risk scoring, Mermaid DFD generation.

name: ocrEngine.ts
description: Layer 4 — OCR pipeline. runOCR() function. Never throws to UI, returns best-effort text with internal error flags.

name: knowledgeIngestionEngine.ts
description: Layer 4 — Enterprise Knowledge RAG ingestion. storeEnterpriseEmbeddings() → db.enterprise_knowledge.

name: SemanticRouter.ts
description: Layer 3 — Autonomous semantic routing. Telemetry-based heuristic routing between Core WebGPU and BYOM providers.

name: SideloadService.ts
description: Layer 3 — OPFS model sideloading. Atomic streaming, GGUF header validation, sneakernet model ingestion.

name: LocalDaemonProvider.ts
description: Layer 4 — WebSocket client to ws://127.0.0.1:8080. Agent Socket Protocol, pending resolver maps, abort signals.

name: StateContext.tsx
description: Layer 2 — React context for global state. Presentation layer. Workflow context resolution, persona adoption.

name: Dashboard.tsx
description: Layer 1 — Main dashboard view. System health, quick actions, recent activity.

name: ReviewExecution.tsx
description: Layer 1 — NSI workflow orchestrator. 5-stage pipeline UI, BDAT scorecard display, HITL gating, RAG context assembly.

name: AgentChat.tsx
description: Layer 1 — Floating chat component. 463 lines (deprioritized refactor to 300-line limit). Multi-persona agent interface.

name: AdminPanel.tsx
description: Layer 1 — Admin panel with 20+ tab components. System config, model management, prompts, guardrails, audit workspace.

name: ThreatEditor.tsx
description: Layer 1 — Threat modeling editor. Auto-save loop, Mermaid DFD rendering, STRIDE analysis UI.

name: IntakeWizard.tsx
description: Layer 1 — Document intake wizard. OCR processing, BIAN extraction, knowledge ingestion.

name: AuthGate.tsx
description: Layer 1 — Authentication gate. PBKDF2 constant-time auth, session management.

name: StructuralVectoriser.ts
description: Layer 4 — Bitfield vectoriser. vectoriseInto() zero-allocation hot path, setBit() bitwise optimization.

name: exportEngine.ts
description: Layer 4 — Document export. PDF, Excel, markdown generation. Encrypted payload export.

name: logger.ts
description: Layer 4 — Centralized logging. The ONLY approved logging mechanism. Replaces all console.log.

name: opfsManager.ts
description: Layer 5 — OPFS file management. FileSystemSyncAccessHandle, atomic streaming, model weight storage.

name: validation.ts
description: Layer 4 — Zod schema validation. All imported data piped through schemas before bulkPut().

name: ocrWorker.ts
description: Layer 5 — OCR Web Worker. Tesseract CDN removed, local /assets/ocr/ assets for air-gap operation.

name: wasmRuntime.ts
description: Layer 5 — Singleton OcrWasmRuntime. isLoaded() requires engine.isLoaded() && hydratedAssets.size >= 2.

name: types.ts

name: preprocessor.ts

name: extractor.ts
